about.title: Designed for Educators, Built for Excellence
about.description: Oimergen was created by educators who understand the challenges of modern assessment. We've combined powerful features with an intuitive interface to help you create professional quizzes that engage students and provide meaningful insights.
about.testimonial: "Oimergen has transformed how I create assessments. The intuitive interface and powerful features save me hours every week!"

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.intro: Oimergen is a Kazakhstani platform for creating modern interactive assignments and tests.
aboutPage.mission: We create a simple tool that helps teachers prepare lesson materials faster, and students learn with greater interest. Instead of complex editors and monotonous assignments, we want to offer a convenient service where creating a quality test takes just a few minutes.
aboutPage.goal: Our goal is to make digital education more accessible and convenient for every school, college, and university in Kazakhstan.
aboutPage.community: We are just starting our journey and actively developing the platform. Therefore, ideas, feedback, and suggestions from users are especially important to us — they help make Oimergen better with every update.
aboutPage.simplicity: Simplicity is more important than complexity.
aboutPage.technology: Technology should help learning, not complicate the process.
aboutPage.closing: Thank you for becoming part of Oimergen. Together we are creating more modern education.
